name: WANTED: Murkdeep!
summary: Auberdine's council wants Murkdeep dead for a Sentinel's death and ships lost off Darkshore. Find the Greymist chieftain south along the coast.

sections.title: A Threat on the Mist-Shrouded Shoals
sections.body: Greymist murlocs are usually a nuisance along Darkshore. Murkdeep has turned against Auberdine, and the wanted poster outside the inn names him as the killer of at least one night elf Sentinel. It also suspects him of sabotaging or wrecking two cargo vessels offshore. With ships lost and raids along the coast, the Auberdine Village Council has set a public bounty on their leader.

sections.title: The Ambush at the Huts
sections.body: Murkdeep lurks off the southern coast near murloc huts clustered around a bonfire. Trespassers face an organized defense as Greymist coastrunners and shore-crawlers surge from the surf to protect their settlement. Then Murkdeep emerges with his vanguard to strike the intruders.

sections.title: Justice for the Fallen
sections.body: Proof of Murkdeep's death answers the Sentinels' grim need. Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea handles the council's bounty payout. With Greymist leadership broken, travelers and ships on Darkshore's foggy coast gain a reprieve from sabotage.

faq.q: Where do I pick up the bounty on Murkdeep?
faq.answer: Find the wanted poster outside the inn in central Auberdine, in Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is the Auberdine council offering a bounty on Murkdeep?
faq.answer: The Auberdine council offers the bounty because Murkdeep killed at least one night elf Sentinel and is suspected of sinking two cargo vessels off Darkshore.
Murkdeep is far south of Auberdine, along the beach by three murloc huts around a bonfire.

faq.q: Why isn't Murkdeep at the murloc camp when I arrive?
faq.answer: Murkdeep stays out of sight. Step between the huts near the bonfire, and Greymist murlocs surge from the ocean in waves. Murkdeep appears with the final wave, after the first defenders fall.

faq.q: Who turns in the quest once Murkdeep is dead?
faq.answer: Report Murkdeep's death to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea, on duty in Auberdine.

faq.q: Are the murlocs at this camp different from other murlocs in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Murkdeep commands the Greymist murlocs, including coastal scouts and warriors who defend their seaside encampment in coordinated waves.

angles.text: As a night elf defending Darkshore, you avenge a fallen Sentinel and protect the lifeline Auberdine's docks provide.
As an Alliance member, you know Auberdine is a vital northern trade hub. The cargo ships Murkdeep is suspected of sinking deal a costly blow to Alliance logistics in Kalimdor.
